name: The majority voted in favour of [part (a)](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-06-27.18.1) of an amendment introduced by ACT Senator [Katy Gallagher](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/katy_gallagher) (Labor), which means it was successful. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add: ", and:* > > *(a) the provisions of the [Nature Positive (Environment Information Australia) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7193) and related bills be referred immediately to the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 8 August 2024; and*
